purpose: Registry of scripts/ scanners and the output category each writes to scripts/outputs/{YYYYMMDDHHMMSS}-{category}.json. Consumed by clean_outputs.py --prune to keep only the latest timestamped output per category.

architecture.description: Component counts per module, submodule structure

doc-links.description: Broken relative links and anchors in markdown

files.description: File counts and lines of code per module

security.description: XSS, CSP, SQL injection, mass assignment, auth, secrets, CSRF, uploads, rate limiting
